_comment: Third-party dataset artifacts from the IssueBench release (Röttger et al., 2025; arXiv:2502.08395), hosted at hf.co/datasets/Paul/IssueBench (CC-BY-4.0). Fetched by scripts/fetch_issuebench.py; NOT committed to this repo (see README.md). Byte sizes are the values reported by the HF tree API at the pinned commit; the fetcher verifies them.

files._comment: Issue metadata (212 political issues; topic_id -> topic_neutral/pro/con framings, tags, source proportions). Small; fetched with every split so the loader can join richer per-issue fields if needed.
150-prompt debug split — the default fetch. Cheap enough for CI and a boundary-check pilot.
636k-prompt sample split (a stratified subsample of the full 2.49m).
Full 2.49m-prompt set, sharded in two parquet files. ~79 MB; only fetch if you actually need the whole bench.
